<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #ffffff; }
    .title-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subtitle-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    .label-a { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #dc2626; }
    .label-b { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #16a34a; }
    .label-c { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2563eb; }
    
    .card-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .formula { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .desc-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #334155; text-anchor: middle; }

    /* Animated Squares & Lines */
    .sq-a { fill: #fca5a5; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #dc2626; stroke-width: 2; animation: pulseA 3s infinite alternate; }
    .sq-b { fill: #86efac; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #16a34a; stroke-width: 2; animation: pulseB 3s infinite alternate; }
    .sq-c { fill: #93c5fd; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #2563eb; stroke-width: 2; animation: pulseC 3s infinite alternate; }
    
    @keyframes pulseA {
      0%, 20% { fill-opacity: 0.2; }
      80%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.65; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseB {
      0%, 20% { fill-opacity: 0.2; }
      80%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.65; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseC {
      0%, 40% { fill-opacity: 0.1; }
      90%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.7; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="600" height="400" />

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="300" y="32" class="title-text">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>

  <!-- Squares on sides (Bounded safely inside ViewBox) -->
  <!-- Square a: left of vertical leg (145 to 220, 155 to 230) -->
  <rect x="145" y="155" width="75" height="75" class="sq-a" />
  <text x="182" y="198" class="label-a" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>

  <!-- Square b: below horizontal leg (220 to 320, 230 to 330) -->
  <rect x="220" y="230" width="100" height="100" class="sq-b" />
  <text x="270" y="285" class="label-b" text-anchor="middle">b²</text>

  <!-- Square c: along hypotenuse (Vertices: 220,155 -> 320,230 -> 395,130 -> 295,55) -->
  <polygon points="220,155 320,230 395,130 295,55" class="sq-c" />
  <text x="307" y="148" class="label-c" text-anchor="middle">c²</text>

  <!-- Triangle -->
  <polygon points="220,155 220,230 320,230" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="3" />
  
  <!-- Right Angle Symbol -->
  <path d="M 220 218 L 232 218 L 232 230" fill="none" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Side Labels -->
  <text x="210" y="198" class="label-a" text-anchor="end">a</text>
  <text x="270" y="222" class="label-b" text-anchor="middle">b</text>
  <text x="278" y="202" class="label-c" text-anchor="start">c</text>

  <!-- Hypotenuse Label Callout -->
  <path d="M 285 188 L 325 170" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <text x="330" y="172" class="label-c" font-size="14" text-anchor="start">hypotenuse</text>

  <!-- Info / Card Panel (Right Side) -->
  <rect x="410" y="60" width="165" height="270" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="2" />
  
  <text x="492" y="90" class="card-title">Formula</text>
  <rect x="425" y="105" width="135" height="45" rx="8" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#bfdbfe" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="492" y="134" class="formula">a² + b² = c²</text>

  <text x="492" y="180" class="card-title">Key Rule</text>
  <text x="492" y="205" class="desc-text">In a right-angled triangle,</text>
  <text x="492" y="223" class="desc-text">the longest side is the</text>
  <text x="492" y="243" class="label-c" font-size="14">hypotenuse</text>
  <text x="492" y="263" class="desc-text">(opposite the right angle).</text>

  <text x="492" y="295" class="desc-text" font-style="italic" fill="#64748b">Area a² + Area b²</text>
  <text x="492" y="312" class="desc-text" font-style="italic" fill="#64748b">= Area c²</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>States of Matter</title>
  <style>
    .title { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .heading { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .desc { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .box { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8px; }
    
    /* Solid Animation: Vibration */
    .s1 { animation: vib1 0.3s infinite alternate ease-in-out; }
    .s2 { animation: vib2 0.25s infinite alternate ease-in-out; }
    @keyframes vib1 { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 100% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } }
    @keyframes vib2 { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 100% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); } }

    /* Liquid Animation: Moving past each other */
    .l1 { animation: liq1 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
